mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive, but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate falls below 4%, but the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both industrial production and payroll employment increase, it indicates economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Both industrial production and payroll employment increase, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Housing starts increase, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in consumer price inflation above 5% leads to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: CPI exceeds 5%, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When real sales increase and unemployment decreases, it signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Real sales rise and unemployment falls, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, slowing industrial production growth signals potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Industrial production growth slows, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 35% of cases.
